body.heading: Where in the world is South Africa?
paragraphs: South Africa is a country in Southern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of South Africa is Pretoria. South Africa has THREE capital cities! Pretoria is where the president and government work, Cape Town is where parliament meets, and Bloemfontein is the home of the highest courts.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in South Africa speak isiZulu, isiXhosa, Afrikaans and English. South Africa has twelve official languages in all — the newest, South African Sign Language, was added in 2023 — one of the highest counts in the world.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of South Africa is the South African rand.

body.heading: How big is South Africa?
paragraphs: South Africa covers about 1,221,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Algeria.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: Table Mountain has a broad flat-looking summit overlooking Cape Town. Table Mountain's flat top often wears a 'tablecloth' of cloud, and a cable car carries families to the top.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Ride the rotating cable car up Table Mountain's flat top for views over Cape Town, its busy harbour and the wide Atlantic Ocean — and look out for dassies, the guinea-pig-like animals sunning on the rocks.
Kruger is one of the world's great safari parks — bigger than some countries — where families can spot the famous Big Five: lion, leopard, elephant, rhino and buffalo.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find South Africa on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
